answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and isolated to the primary region during peak settlement, so the closest prior success is a clean regional traffic shift that restored latency without dropping writes. Rollback is unavailable because the in-flight security patch must stay. Circuit breaking would fail customer writes, which violates the objective. Read-replica offload and extra capacity remain plausible if primary overload rather than a regional fault is the true cause, so those analogs need archive checks before lock-in. Failover during peak settlement can still disrupt in-flight writes, and it is uncertain whether the new release is already in the other region.
